definition: Artificial intelligence in architecture is the use of artificial intelligence in automation, design, and planning in the architectural process or in assisting human skills in the field of architecture.
details: AI has been used by some architects for design, and has been proposed as a way to automate planning and routine tasks in the field.

explainer.lead: Artificial intelligence in architecture means using AI to help with architectural design, planning, and automation. Its purpose is to support architects’ skills and take over some routine work, rather than treating building design as a fully automatic process.

tiers.eli5: Imagine a computer helper that can suggest building layouts and handle some repetitive planning work while an architect makes the decisions. AI in architecture is that kind of helper: it assists people with designing and planning buildings.
tiers.practitioner: Architects can apply AI within design and planning workflows to generate assistance or automate routine tasks. Its outputs remain inputs to the architectural process, where human skills and review are still needed.
tiers.paperLevel: Artificial intelligence in architecture is the application of AI to automation, design, and planning within architectural processes, or to the augmentation of human architectural skills. Its proposed roles include design assistance, planning automation, and the automation of routine tasks.

explainer.example: An architect uses AI assistance while developing a building design, then applies AI to automate a routine planning task. The architect incorporates the useful assistance into the project rather than handing over the entire architectural process.

usedIn.name: Architectural design
usedIn.detail: Some architects use AI to assist with design work.

usedIn.name: Architectural planning
usedIn.detail: AI has been proposed as a way to automate parts of planning.

usedIn.name: Routine task automation
usedIn.detail: AI can be applied to repetitive tasks within the architectural process.

explainer.intuition: Think of AI as an assistant inside the architectural workflow: it can help produce or process design and planning work while architects supply human judgment and skills.
howItWorks: An architect works on a design or planning task.
AI assists with part of that task or automates a routine step.
The resulting assistance feeds back into the architectural process.
The architect continues the work using human skills alongside the AI assistance.
explainer.whyItMatters: It offers a way to assist architects and reduce routine effort in design and planning. This makes AI part of the architectural process while keeping human skills relevant.
misconceptions: It does not necessarily mean that AI designs buildings without architects.
It covers planning and routine-task automation as well as design assistance.
Using AI in architecture is not the same as automating the entire architectural process.
